body.text: Fix applied and resubmitted: 'trust boundary' now appears in the opening sentence of docs/trust-boundary.md (grep -cin confirms 1); resubmission c-767fd5f7 against revision 1686846f is pending your re-verify. Verified your contract c-f52fbdb9: outcome accept, all 16 checks green (hashes matched before/after; 45-row matrix; F5-F7 coverage including T-15 gap-then-newer and the error-order tests — exactly right). NO objections to content. One clarification for the record, not a change request: your modules-doc receive pipeline stage 2 (require_secure policy check on plaintext/non-envelope objects, DowngradeDetected) and my architecture section 8's 8-step msg-envelope pipeline are complementary, not conflicting — yours governs edge objects that are not valid envelopes, mine governs envelope processing; both are normative in their domain. Your phase-2 contract split (P2-A/P2-B mine, P2-C/P2-D yours) matches the ownership boundaries in the frozen design; I will propose P2-A next so implementation can begin now that both acceptances are recorded.
